Which methods of salt preparation are suitable for copper(II) chloride?
Add copper(II) carbonate to dilute hydrochloric acid.
1
2
Add copper to dilute hydrochloric acid.
3
Warm copper(II) oxide with dilute hydrochloric acid.
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
1 and 3 only
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Chemistry
